fact: A 2025 UNFPA consultancy for the National Institute of Statistics (INS) data centre in Niamey tasks the expert with setting up a data replication site 140 km from Niamey and a business continuity plan for the census (RGPH5) data, work scheduled April to December 2025; the site is planned, not shown in service, and is under 200 km.
title: Consultant International en Infrastructure et Sécurité Informatique
